name: robots/lifelong-robot-learning__libero
title: LIBERO OffScreenRenderEnv tabletop manipulation
intro: LIBERO OffScreenRenderEnv tabletop manipulation, adapted from lifelong-robot-learning/libero. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 3 more; runs `reset` and `step`. `reset`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
